blurb: Nestled in Bedford lies the Job Lane House, a testament to American resilience and history that dates back over three centuries. From its origins in 1664, when housewright Job Lane transformed the land into a home, to its days as a bustling farm under the Dutton family, the house embodies the spirit of its era.
